info.title: TriageRAG Clinical Console API
info.description:
Deterministic emergency-triage decision support API. 

**DISCLAIMER:** Research prototype. Synthetic data only. Not a medical device. Not for clinical use.

AVPU+C scale: A (Alert), C (New Confusion), V (Voice), P (Pain), U (Unresponsive).
